newsitem.title: JORDAN: King Hussein talks with FBI chief on closer ties.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein talks with FBI chief on closer ties.

text.p: King Hussein held talks with U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) director Louis Freeh on enhancing intelligence and security cooperation, Jordanian officials said on Friday.

Officials declined to say if Freeh, who met the king in the presence of the kingdom's intelligence and public security chiefs late on Thursday, discussed the case of Mousa Abu Marzook, a leading member of the Islamic resistance group Hamas who is in a New York prison facing deportation to Israel.

Israeli security sources have said Israeli officials, fearing violent protests if Marzook ended up in an Israeli jail, were examining a deal with U.S. and Jordanian officials to send Marzook to Jordan in return for a pledge to shun violence.
Jordan's Justice Minister Abdul-Karim al-Dughmi said last week Freeh's delegation would hold "detailed talks" on the case of Marzook.

The U.S. embassy said on Thursday Freeh was in the Middle East to open FBI attache offices in Israel and Egypt, and was coming to Jordan "in response to an invitation extended by law enforcement officials of Jordan."
